answer: A sybil attacker forging N identities must acquire N distinct pearls and post N sable bonds, so cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest participants recover stakes on exit. Each agent must stake a unique pearl token minted to one hardware-sealed key, and registration only happens on the terrace ledger after a sable-bond escrow of 500 tokens locks for three epochs.
